# Load data to prepare for cleaning and renaming
```{r}
#| label: load-data

gic_raw <- read_xlsx(here("data", "IPROTECTARetrospecti_DATA_2025-08-19_2157 FINAL SHEET.xlsx"))
```
## Clean up variable names, convert to appropriate data types
```{r}
#| label: variable_mapping

map_path <- here("data", "variable_map.csv")

if (!file.exists(map_path)) {
  map_df <- tibble(
    raw_name = names(gic_raw),
    new_name = names(gic_raw),
    description = ""
  )
  
  write_csv(map_df, map_path)
}
```
